chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The pregnant woman whose husband dies, is maintained from the wealth of the child in her womb.
It is noted that Muhammad ibn Muslim, the narrator of this hadith, has narrated it in agreement with what we have previously presented; he narrated that.

key_terms.مِنْ مَالِ وَلَدِهَا: From the wealth of her child
key_terms.يُنْفَقُ عَلَيْهَا: She is maintained / provision is given for her

ai.seo_question: Who pays for the maintenance of a pregnant widow during her waiting period?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Isfabar clarifies the mechanism of nafaqah for a pregnant widow, specifying that her sustenance is allocated from the unborn child's share of the inheritance, a ruling supported by the consensus of the narrators including Muhammad ibn Muslim. This legal nuance distinguishes the source of funds as the child's prospective inheritance rather than a direct expenditure from the husband's general estate, reflecting the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on precise inheritance distribution during the 'iddah period.
